title: New Quantum LDPC Codes with Good Parameters
exact_target: Construct additional quantum LDPC code families with positive asymptotic rate and relative distance.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006387 (OWR-14299517-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

New Mathematical Directions in Coding Theory (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/41, pp. 2187--2242. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: Asymptotically good quantum LDPC families already exist. The source asks for new families or constructions, rather than the historical existence question.
